summary: Backend-only testing for LeadGen Command Center. All 15 pytest cases pass covering auth (login/register/me), categories, search+mock persistence, leads filter/patch/delete/export, analytics summary shape, schedules CRUD + run + partial PATCH (the reported fix), and settings get/post persistence. Google Places is BLOCKED on live provider (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY empty) — verified via is_mock=true; live provider path NOT exercised (integration_context: user_provided_key not supplied).

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' from env is invalid per CORS spec (browsers will reject credentialed requests). Set explicit origins in CORS_ORIGINS.

Jobs are lost on restart because register_job uses in-memory job store; scheduled jobs re-registered via load_existing_schedules on startup — ok, but no persistence of run history apart from last_run.
Mock filter uses substring match on ' '.join(types); may over-match (e.g., 'car' matches 'car_rental' & 'car_repair'). Not a blocker.
POST accepts empty string for google_maps_api_key (used above to reset); consider explicit DELETE endpoint or validation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Provide a real GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY to verify live Google Places (New) + Geocoding integration end-to-end (currently unverified — only mock path exercised).
OPTIONAL: Fix CORS config to not combine allow_credentials=True with wildcard origins.
OPTIONAL: Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown to lifespan handler to remove deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/schedules correctly uses new ScheduleUpdate model with all Optional fields — partial update {active:false} verified working.
get_current_user properly strips _id and password_hash from returned user.
Leads endpoints and search use user_id scoping, so multi-tenant isolation is correct.
server.py is ~570 lines and single-file; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers/services if it grows further.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (user explicitly opted for simple JWT+localStorage per prev context — not required).

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15) on mock path; live Google Places path unverified: no-user-key-provided

test_credentials: admin@leadfinder.io / Admin@123 (verified working; auto-seeded on startup)
seed_data_creation: Registered a random test_<hex>@test.io user during test_register_new_user; POST /api/search populated leads for admin user (mock data). Test schedule 'TEST daily restaurants' was created and deleted within the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env auto-loaded. Admin creds seeded on startup. Google Places live path was NOT tested — GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is empty. All 17 features listed in the review request map to passing test cases.
rca of the issue: No production bug found. The reported fix (ScheduleUpdate model with all Optional fields to support partial PATCH) is present at lines 105-112 of server.py and verified by test_schedule_crud_and_run which sends {active:false} only and confirms 200 + partial update + preserved other fields.
